name: Pitaya!
detailed_description:
About This Game

Eat to live. Fight to grow. Cook to survive.

Pitaya! is a third-person action RPG where you play as a cursed girl with an insatiable hunger. To stave off the effects of a monstrous curse, you must explore a strange and decaying world, devour powerful enemies, and cook their remains into exotic dishes that unlock new skills, abilities, and upgrades.

🥄 A Hunger-Fueled Combat System

Master fast-paced, hack-and-slash combat where eating enemies mid-fight can heal you, power you up, or push you deeper into your curse. Balance your need to feed with the risks of going too far.

🥘 Cook Your Skill Tree

Gather ingredients from fallen foes and hidden corners of the world. Then return to your home base and use your kitchen to craft meals—each one unlocking new combat abilities, movement options, or passive perks.

🧭 Explore a Twisted World

Some paths are blocked by challenges you can only overcome with the right recipe. You can’t jump, but you can fall—intentionally or not.

🐾 Raise or Roast Your Pets

Find and feed mysterious creatures known as Kneadlings. These doughy companions can help you fight or offer powerful effects...if you choose to keep them around. But sometimes, the best meal is a familiar one...

🔧 Upgrade Yourself Through Flavor

Progression is about finding better ingredients, discovering new recipes, and carefully planning how you satisfy your curse without losing yourself to it.
